audit.why: 49.03% over 1489 games: Sett owns levels 1-5 outright against the weakest early laner in the game, then loses the lane permanently from her first item and level 11. EVEN / 4/10 with Kayle carry threat 6/10 is a fair read of a lane that is easy to win and hard to convert.
audit.corrected: Early is free, late is unwinnable — difficulty 4/10 in lane, but the clock is Kayle's.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers gave Sett all seven rows. The packet levelChart hands first item and two-plus items to Kayle, and the mirror already flipped rows 4-6 to Skill / Kayle / Kayle. The content whys already contradict their own tokens: whys[5] says 'Kayle's first-item and level 11 ranged spike lets her out-trade Sett' while win[5] said Sett.
audit.why: Packet, mirror and the page's own prose all agree Kayle takes over at first item; only the tokens were wrong. Level 6 is a genuine skill read because a saved Divine Judgment voids the all-in.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Sett / Sett / Sett / Sett / Skill / Kayle / Kayle in both layers, ratings re-scaled, and the two full-layer whys that still claimed Sett-favoured item spikes rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Starfire Spellblade (E) was described as 'range poke'. It is an auto-attack reset that empowers her next attack with missing-health damage — the wind-up is the tell, not a cast. Divine Judgment carried no cooldown anywhere despite being the whole matchup, and Radiant Blast's resistance shred was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text: E active 'smites her target with celestial fire, dealing bonus damage proportionate to their missing health' with autoReset flagged and a 6-8s cooldown. Q reduces the resistances of all hit, which is why her follow-up damage lands so hard on a Sett who just ate it. R is 160/120/80 — the longest cooldown in either kit by a wide margin.
audit.corrected: Starfire Spellblade is an auto reset on 8s at rank 1, react to the wind-up. Radiant Blast (12s, 900 range) shreds resistances before her burst. Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1, 120s at rank 2 — baiting it buys over two minutes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Executioner's Calling appears in report[8] but the reason is worded as 'his healing', and no field ties the anti-heal to Celestial Blessing's flat 15s cadence.
audit.why: missingInteractions flagged needs-antiheal; W is a flat 15s heal at every rank, which is what beats Sett in extended trades once she is levelled.
audit.corrected: Celestial Blessing heals every 15s flat — Grievous Wounds before any extended trade.

edits.before: The Show Stopper online — you can start fights Kayle doesn't want. Suplex her into your wave or tower, never into her own minions.
edits.after: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 — bait it and 6 is yours, eat it and your R is wasted. Suplex her into your wave, never into hers.

edits.before: Stridebreaker fixes your only weakness — sticking to Kayle. Shove, recall on the spike, and force the next trade before she matches your item.
edits.after: First item is hers: level 11 gives ranged autos, and her E plus a flat 15s Celestial Blessing out-sustains your grit. Stop forcing extended trades.

edits.before: Sterak's makes your all-in nearly unburstable. Fights are decided by whether you cash a max-grit W — track Divine Judgment (Invuln) and commit on the gap.
edits.after: Two items in she outscales you outright — ranged form, sustain, and Divine Judgment down to 80s. Your only fight is a Show Stopper pick while her R is down.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment (Invuln): matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Kayle Divine Judgment: Makes an ally INVULNERABLE briefly, then bursts around them. Dodge or sidestep it.
edits.after: - Divine Judgment: 160s at rank 1, 120s at rank 2 — bait it and she is naked for over two minutes. - Radiant Blast (Q): 12s at rank 1, 900 range, shreds your resistances on hit. - Celestial Blessing (W): flat 15s heal.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Divine Judgment (Invuln): when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve her.
edits.after: Trade around Divine Judgment's 160s: down, run the pattern; up, give nothing. Her W heals every 15s flat, so buy Executioner's before long trades.

edits.before: Kayle is one of the weakest early laners: with Q Knuckle Down and E Facebreaker you walk her down and chunk her every trade, and her only defense is E Starfire Spellblade range poke, which you close instantly. Deny CS and keep her off levels.
edits.after: Kayle is one of the weakest early laners: Knuckle Down plus Facebreaker walks her down every wave. Starfire Spellblade is an auto reset, not poke — step back on her wind-up and punish the 8s gap after it. Deny CS and keep her off levels.

notes: Facebreaker (E) only stuns enemies on OPPOSITE sides of Sett — against a solo Kayle with the wave behind you it is a slow, which the mirror identified as the most useful fact in this lane and which still does not appear on Sett's page in any field I could rewrite inside the length band. Worth adding as a create-only edit if a field opens up. sett.json's grounding flag on The Show Stopper is not in Riot's text, so I made no claim about it denying her movement.
